description.value: Jamaican Kitchen is a family-owned Caribbean restaurant on Kamloops' Tranquille Road, founded by Red Seal chef Kamau Metsimela and his wife Denese, who brought authentic Jamaican home-style cooking to BC's interior in 2012. The casual spot serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner featuring jerk dishes, johnnycakes, island-spiced French toast, and creative twists on Canadian favourites, with a soundtrack of Bob Marley to match. Cyclists can fuel up with hearty plates or order for pickup via the online shop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a family-owned Jamaican restaurant at 451 Tranquille Rd operated by Red Seal chef Kamau Metsimela; the /shop/ page and homepage both confirm pickup and delivery, and the menu explicitly lists Vegetarian Benedict, Vegan Skillet, and a Vegan Grab and Go Sandwich. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere in OSM or the website. Two concerns surfaced: the postal code differs between OSM (V2B 3H2) and the contact page (V2B 3H3), and the website's front page contains injected gambling/casino spam text suggesting the site may have been compromised.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM has V2B 3H2, website contact page shows V2B 3H3. Website value used as it is likely more current.
Website front page contains injected gambling/casino spam text, suggesting the site may have been compromised. Core content (menu, contact, our story) appears intact and legitimate.

OSM opening hours (Thu–Sat until 20:00) conflict with website contact page hours (all open days close at 3:00 pm, Tuesday closed). Hours excluded per rules but the discrepancy is notable for data quality.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, established sit-down and takeout restaurant serving substantial meals in Kamloops; a useful fuelling stop for touring cyclists on the Tranquille Road corridor.
